body:
- For an individual investor, the practical Claude stack is: equity-research + financial-analysis plugins (skills work without paid connectors if you supply filings) + one cheap data MCP (Financial Datasets/Alpha Vantage/Yahoo for US; Kite MCP/Trendlyne for India) + saved red-team prompts.
- Institutional connectors (FactSet, S&P, Morningstar) are the main moat of "Claude for Financial Services"; retail users will mostly lack them.
